description: Empirical verification of the full-twist Δ_n² scalar action q^{c(λ)} per Wedderburn block V_λ ↪ H_n(q). Tabulates c(λ) for every partition λ ⊢ n at n ∈ {1,...,12}; identifies the Δ_n²-invariant subspace (c(λ) = 0); records magic-n empirical realisability of the categorical-neutrality predicate (prop:categorical-neutrality-saturated-shells). Structural finding: at magic n = 2 the invariant subspace is empty under pure-scalar q^c(λ) action, indicating the conjecture must hold via a refined mechanism (root-of-unity specialisation, sum cancellation, or a non-scalar action component captured in T2/T3).
structural_finding: At magic n=2 no λ has c(λ) = 0; pure scalar Δ_n² action would force Φ_n = 0. The categorical-neutrality proposition therefore holds via a refined mechanism — either q at a root of unity, sum cancellation, or a non-scalar action component.
